legend_note: Higher is more habitable in 2050 (+2.7 °C). Eleven indicators in six equal categories — heat, fire weather, drought and clay, floods, coast, lack of services — each scored 0–100, mostly as a position among French communes, and the score is 100 minus their average. Median commune 60; the Aude and Roussillon coast is lowest, inland Normandy and Brittany highest. It says where, not how much: a green commune is less exposed than most, not safe. Method after Projet Celsius; fire is interim (weather only, underrates the Landes pine forest). Click a commune for the six categories.
